description: Somos un equipo con mucha pasión por el espacio y la NASA y queremos expandir nuestras habilidades y conocimientos a través de este reto. Combinamos habilidades en arte, diseño, programación, UX/UI. Además tenemos experiencia en creación de plataformas y videojuegos en maratones de desarrollo de 48 horas donde hemos logrado crear diferentes demos.
summary: Mars Explorers is a 2D videogame that helps students navigate through what is needed in a Mars Mission, they need to have in mind which kind of Mission they want to do, which kind of rover they need to use depending of the instruments needed, what Rocket, fuel, what will be the best launch date and the velocity they need to use to achieve the mission in Mars. They are a mission controler NASA expert and have to choose the correct answers to be able to win.
details: Mars Explorers help students navigate through what is it like to be in an space mission and what they need to have in mind in a really interactive and simple way, it helps students understand what is behind a true Space Rover Mission and what do they have to have in mind when NASA teams plan these kinds of missions. With this, students can learn and practice in a really simple and interactive way thing that are really difficult and inspire themselves into become one of these great engineers that work in NASA. All the graphics were created using AI generation with chatgpt but edited in photoshop so all the graphics were in the same line and theme and had coherence with the whole theme, also the code was supported by chatgpt AI with questions of how the code could be implemented in GODOT, a videogame engine where we developed the game, and all searched tools available by NASA where we gathered all the information needed .
